title: GTA 6's Wildest Trailer Clips Really Happened (Two Weren't Even in Florida) 📱 #Shorts
description:
Fans matched clips from GTA 6's first trailer to real viral videos: the woman dancing on a speeding car (Miami, 2017), the purple-haired "Florida Joker" mugshot (2017), the Wheels Up, Guns Down dirt bike rideouts (Miami-Dade/Broward, 2018), the hammer lady (Chatsworth, California, 2020) and the nearly naked man running from a cop (Oakville, Ontario, Canada, 2022).

Source: GTA BOOM, "Real-life moments behind GTA 6 Trailer 1" (gtaboom.com). These are fan/outlet comparisons; Rockstar has not commented on them. Footage: official Grand Theft Auto VI Trailer 1 (Rockstar Games).

GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
